title: Aurora rumoured at RAF Machrihanish

tellings.quote: there were rumors it was based out of the UK for a while at a remote Scottish base called RAF Machrihanish.

plain: Aurora, a rumoured secret American aircraft, was said for a while to be flying out of a remote Scottish airbase called RAF Machrihanish, run by Britain's Royal Air Force, sometime between the late 1980s and late 1990s. A researcher and writer named Nick Cook mentions it on Michels' show as something he heard, without naming a source: "there were rumors it was based out of the UK for a while." If true, it would mean a hidden American project was operating from British soil.
